  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The fenced bundle output template contains the guidance line "(one line per plan, prerequisites first — the anchor line follows any member it depends on)", which a literal-reading agent can emit verbatim into the user's report.
  WHY: The command says to replace the final block with this template, so meta-commentary can leak into the user-facing output (both reviewers rated it NIT; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a hardening suggestion).
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:42 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The em-dash parenthetical "only an anchor whose own prerequisites are all shipped; a blocked anchor is never recommended, per the rule above" follows the unqualified default "the recommendation stays the single anchor plan", and "per the rule above" is a vague back-reference.
  WHY: A step-by-step reader may apply the default before reading the qualifier and recommend a blocked anchor (rated NIT).
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:88 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Blocked-on-prerequisite row template mixes evidence sub-forms, so the in-flight and over-caps cases lack the path and issue/PR detail that the screened-out case has.
  WHY: Step 6 requires every screened-out candidate to cite the blocking issue/PR and overlapping paths (rated NIT).
